summary.name: Illuminated Manuscript, an extracted Illustration and Art Media style sampled from Fable gallery frames on 2026-10-13. Medium labels are authored classifications.
summary.visualIdentity: A stable parchment page with a framed original miniature, vine border, vector-interlace initial and restrained gilded highlights in red, blue and green pigment. Illustration and verified text form a page, not a generic paper scene.
summary.suitableUses: Explicitly suited to manuscript-style pages that mix ornamental illustration with verified text. Inferred: calm, reading-paced explainers where page framing aids comprehension. Suitability rests on sampled frames, not full playback.
summary.limitations: Only verified copy may appear; otherwise the text column stays blank ruling, never pseudo-script. The page turn is a full-video option only and is excluded from the preview. Hex values are suggested defaults, not measured source colors.
summary.palette: Authored fallback roles: paper #EFE4C8, outlines and text #352D27, gilded shapes only #B89B51, red #A5433C, blue #3C5487, green #66825D. Gradients are disabled; use pigment layering and texture. Approved task colors take precedence. Normal text targets 4.5:1 contrast on the actual composited texture.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Static page with no camera tilt in preview. Timed beats: 0–0.9s initial outline draws, then fills; 0.6–1.6s border draws with leaf fills after each stroke; 1.2–2.2s miniature frame completes before its art reveals (data-reveal-after set to the frame id); 2.2–2.8s masked gold sweep plus one small gesture; then hold. Interactivity is unspecified.
summary.audio: Unspecified by the style, and no audio was supplied. Do not assume a historical soundtrack. Honor any supplied audio and use silent catalog previews. Music, voiceover, effects and ambience are optional; quiet texture or silence suits reading holds, and speech must stay intelligible.
summary.assetRequirements: Needed: SVG ornament for the border and initial, an original flat-pigment miniature, a locally loaded approved font for HTML/CSS text, and verified copy. Optional: approved parchment scans beneath the vectors, seeded grain and deckle edge, or layered high-resolution art for a push-in.
summary.combinations: Optional example: style-031 as a secondary illustrative detail, not a limit. Keep this medium and approved colors dominant, use one animation owner per property, and avoid generic effects or invented historical text. No motion references or available library IDs are selected.
summary.productionApproach: SVG and HTML/CSS own drawing and typography; GSAP with DrawSVGPlugin owns the timed drawing and reveals; chroma.js is optional for palette and contrast checks. HyperFrames is the default pipeline; Remotion is a fallback only with a recorded, verified reason. Canvas, WebGL, bloom, PBR gold and ScrambleText were rejected.
